text: Measured against this study's survey data, the SEC marginally overestimated the cost of the initial Form PF filing for both annually filing smaller advisers and quarterly filing larger advisers.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Fund Disclosures Under the Dodd-Frank Act (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2447306

isBasedOn.name: Private Fund Disclosures Under the Dodd-Frank Act

abstract: The cross-comparison suggests that the SEC may be marginally overestimating the cost of Form PF filings for both annually filing smaller private fund advisers and quarterly filing larger private fund advisers.
